bullets.text: Highlight Reels for Xbox Insiders - **Xbox** Insiders can now create highlight reels via the Xbox PC app.
Malware Targeting Workplace Apps - **Microsoft Defender** identified signed malware impersonating workplace applications to deploy RMM backdoors.
JavaScript AI Build-a-thon Launch - A hands-on program to integrate AI into JavaScript applications kicks off today.
GitHub Copilot Dev Days Announced - A series of events to enhance AI-assisted development in **Visual Studio** and **VS Code**.
OAuth Redirection Abuse Detected - **Microsoft** warns of phishing campaigns exploiting OAuth mechanisms for malware delivery.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features and improvements rolled out in the latest **Windows 11** Insider builds.
Microsoft and OpenAI Partnership Continues - **Microsoft** reaffirms its strong collaboration with **OpenAI** in advancing AI technologies.
New Cloud PC Devices Unveiled - **Microsoft** announces upcoming Cloud PC devices designed for **Windows 365**.
Threat Modeling for AI Applications - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for tailored threat modeling in AI systems.
